interpretation.data_origin: CelesTrak describes GP data as government-provided and fitted to U.S. Space Surveillance Network observations.
interpretation.record_type: Brouwer mean elements for SGP4 propagation, not osculating insertion elements.
interpretation.object_scope: Each launch has one payload and one upper-stage rocket-body record. The rocket-body fit is not a launch-vehicle ascent state history.
interpretation.uncertainty: No covariance or stated orbit-fit accuracy is included in the source records.
interpretation.validation_scope: Supports explicitly labeled postlaunch SGP4 orbit-fit comparisons only. It does not support ascent validation, separation-state validation, or vehicle-parameter inference.

data_rights.classification: All four source records are marked U (unclassified).
data_rights.license: No separate redistribution license was identified in the cited CelesTrak documentation. The package MIT license does not apply to this dataset.
data_rights.usage_policy: Follow the current CelesTrak usage policy when retrieving data; request only needed records and do not query more frequently than documented.
